incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT • latency.p99 > 1200ms in eu-west-1 for /v1/generate (service: inference-api). Auto-page fired at 02:14 UTC.
jamie: ack oncall — I'm taking this.
jamie: seeing p99 ~1.3s, p95 ~250ms. tail looks spiky since 02:12.
alex: fyi logs show a lot of tokenizer restarts on a few nodes + KV miss rate jumped ~40%.
priya: thanks — which model/route is hot?
alex: mostly model=gpt-small-quantized on route /v1/generate (eu-west pool). metrics: cpu in sidecar spiking, sleepy tokenization threads.
jamie: can we route traffic to a less-quantized variant temporarily?
priya: plan: 1) canary-route 15% traffic to model=gpt-small-fp16 fallback; 2) scale sidecar concurrency + prewarm 4 more instances; 3) bump KV cache TTL to reduce misses.
jamie: doing canary now — applying route override.
incident-bot: PagerDuty • Routing change applied: 15% -> gpt-small-fp16 (canary).
alex: curl check: `GET /metrics?route=/v1/generate` -> p99 down to ~650ms for canary. adding a small warmup script: `for p in $(cat top-prefixes); do curl /prefetch?prefix=$p; done`
liu: any confirmed customer impact? support queue showing 3 flagged tickets complaining slow completions, no 5xxs.
jamie: updating status page to "Degraded performance — eu-west" and posting brief note to CS.
priya: starting sidecar scale/rolling prewarm now. also kicking off a KV prefretch job to warm hot keys.
jamie: pagerduty acknowledge logged. handing monitoring to priya in ~20m — will leave runbook steps below.
priya: ack. I'll watch until stable and then continue root cause. initial suspicion: tokenizer worker OOM+restarts causing coldstart tail.
jamie: runbook notes: `1) route override -> fallback; 2) scale sidecars; 3) warm KV; 4) monitor p99 for 30m; 5) if >1s escalate to eng-runtime`
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty • Incident acknowledged by jamie.
incident-bot: Auto-snooze set for 30 minutes (will re-alert if p99 > 1s).
priya: p99 trending down to ~480ms after warmup and routing. keeping an eye on KV hitrate.
liu: leaving CS note: "2 users saw slow completions in EU for ~20 minutes, mitigated by routing. Monitoring continues."
jamie: handing off oncall -> priya. if p99 spikes above 1s again, @priya escalate to eng-runtime. I'm stepping out. :white_check_mark:
